candidate_scope: station-only native operating benchmark; no depot home allocation selected

capacity.scope: Two trainsets per selected station plus explicitly allocated depot stabling; workshop bays are separate

hybrid_allocation.scope: Two revenue trainsets per station where fleet permits; all remaining revenue stock and reserves allocated to storage on their own line

limitations: Initial queues are balanced across powered station/direction choices; this is not a surveyed parking layout.
Declared spares and cold reserves remain parked and charge; automatic substitution, defect routing and maintenance release are not modelled.
Returning trains hold at selected powered stations after service ends; no train is teleported back to its initial placement.
Reference platform berths are an optimistic length/count comparison, not verified parking capacity; dedicated sidings and workshop bays receive no automatic credit.
Station berths, crossovers and shared junction conflicts are outside the simplified interstation movement-authority graph.
Existing depot/station energy quantities and service schedules are preserved, not accepted as correctly sized.

native_hybrid_candidate.scope: same-line home returns and separate depot storage; yard geometry unverified

open_gates: security, CCTV, remote isolation and release inspection
reserve activation, defect routing and maintenance allocation
evening placement and morning demand/headway validation

policy.depot_role: overnight stabling of remaining revenue trains and reserves, maintenance, inspection and defective trains
policy.healthy_fleet_location: two revenue trainsets per selected station; remaining fleet at storage on its own line
policy.start_rule: line service start, subject to energy, headway and movement-authority gates

station_capacity.scope: Two trainsets per selected station plus explicitly allocated depot stabling; workshop bays are separate
